newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil allows Arab Bank to raise ABC-Roma stake.
newsitem.headline: Brazil allows Arab Bank to raise ABC-Roma stake.

text.p: Brazil's National Monetary Council (CMN) Thursday authorized the Arab Bank Corporation to increase to 100 percent its stake in local bank ABC-Roma, Central Bank Director of Controls Alkimar Moura said.

Moura said the Arab bank, whose controllers include federal authorities of Abu Dhabi, Kuwait and Libya, already owned 49.9 percent and would buy the remaining shares from Brazil's Globopar, the group owned by businessman Roberto Marinho.
The buy-out must still be authorized by a presidential decree.
Moura said he did not know how much money was involved but added that the Arab Bank Corporation would pay a 5.0 million reais entry fee to the Central Bank.
